pickerDesc.zh: 使用 Claude 风格重绘模型选择器菜单。
pickerDesc.en: Redraw the model picker menu in Claude style.

modelDescriptionsDesc.zh: 在模型一级列表中显示模型功能说明。
modelDescriptionsDesc.en: Show description lines for models in the primary picker list.

teamDescription.zh: 通过共享任务板协调多个智能体的分工与进度，复杂任务表现更佳，token 开销也相应更高。
teamDescription.en: Coordinates several agents through a shared task board. Complex tasks go better, and token use rises with it.

teamFailed.zh: 无法确认智能体团队协作设置已保存，请重试：{message}
teamFailed.en: Could not confirm the agent teamwork setting was saved. Try again: {message}

teamDisableTitle.zh: 确认停用智能体团队协作？

teamDisableDescription.zh: 对话过程中停用智能体团队协作，将停止共享任务工具和团队协调指令。
teamDisableDescription.en: Disabling agent teamwork during a conversation stops the use of shared task tools and team coordination instructions.

teamDisableWarning.zh: 停用后可能影响缓存复用、增加后续 token 用量与开销，并影响当前任务的协作效果。
teamDisableWarning.en: Disabling it may affect cache reuse, increase subsequent token usage and costs, and affect collaboration on the current task.
